item.title: Greater Toronto home sales up year-over-year for first time in six months: TRREB
item.description: TORONTO — Home sales in the Greater Toronto Area rose on a year-over-year basis in March for the first time in six months, while average selling prices moved lower again.

item.title: Iran has allowed two French former detainees to leave the country, Macron says
item.description: PARIS (AP) — Iran has allowed two French former detainees, Cécile Kohler and Jacques Paris, to leave the country, French President Emmanuel Macron said Tuesday.

item.title: Over 80 migrants are missing from a boat that capsized after leaving Libya, UN says
item.description: CAIRO (AP) — More than 80 migrants went missing after a boat that departed a Libyan coastal town capsized in the central Mediterranean, the U.N. migration agency said Tuesday. The bodies of at least two of them have been recovered.

item.description: MADISON, Wis. (AP) — The board that runs the Universities of Wisconsin voted unanimously Tuesday to fire the system’s president, drawing the ire of Republican lawmakers who called it a “partisan hatchet job.

item.title: 'War crimes': Iranian Canadians horrified by Trump's latest threat to destroy Iran
item.description: TORONTO — Foad Farhani was driving to work Tuesday morning when his wife called him in tears while reading U.S. President Donald Trump’s post on Truth Social threatening the existence of their homeland.

item.title: 'Tyranny of the minority': Court hears injunction bid on Alberta separation petition
item.description: EDMONTON — A court hearing began Tuesday for an Alberta First Nation's request to at least temporarily put on ice a petition to force a vote on whether the province should quit Canada.

item.title: American journalist Shelly Kittleson has been released week after kidnapping in Iraq, Rubio says
item.description: BAGHDAD (AP) — American journalist Shelly Kittleson , who was kidnapped from a Baghdad streetcorner last week, was released Tuesday, U.S. and Iraqi officials said.

item.title: Death of unhoused migrant in Montreal was avoidable, community workers say
item.description: MONTRÉAL — A Montreal community worker says she tried to help a 42-year-old undocumented migrant weeks before he died on the street in the Park Extension neighbourhood.

item.title: Trade agreement talks unlikely to be resolved by July 1: U.S. trade representative
item.description: WASHINGTON — United States Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said Tuesday that he doesn't expect negotiations on the Canada-U.S.-Mexico Agreement on trade to be resolved by July 1.

item.title: Almost a third of police probes of diplomatic missions see subjects leave Canada
item.description: OTTAWA — Almost a third of police probes involving members of foreign diplomatic missions in Canada in the last five years saw the subjects of the investigations leave the country before charges were laid or prosecuted.
